title: Glass Island
style: Cinematic painted key art for a modern real-time strategy game, the look of classic Command and Conquer box art: dramatic light, rich colour, crisp detail, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no letters, no flags, no insignia.

music.caption: cold stealthy cinematic underscore, ticking clock percussion, low pulsing synth bass, distant metallic hums, a held breath, tension building to a sudden release, no vocals

shots.prompt: An uncharted island at night seen from the sea: black glass sensor masts on the cliffs, each with a single cold white strobe, a fortified black glass vault building lit in cold light on the plateau, mist over black water, ominous.
shots.line: The island no chart names is real, and its masts see everything.

shots.prompt: A small team landing from a black rubber boat on a dark rocky beach at night: a young woman commando in 1950s fatigues with a dark ponytail leading, a modern marine network specialist with a laptop case and a marine with a rifle behind her, crouching low, moonlight on wet rocks.
shots.line: Three of them go in. Tanya, a network specialist, and one marine.
shots.action: The team moves forward in a low crouch; waves wash over the rocks.

shots.prompt: Keep this man's face, hair, headset and uniform exactly. Night on the deck of a ship, a dark island on the horizon behind him with tiny white strobes, his face lit by a screen, intent and still.
shots.line: Commander Lin Haoran watches from the ship. Nothing on that island can be allowed to see them.

shots.prompt: A cone of pale white light sweeping across wet black rocks from a black glass mast at night, and a young woman commando with a dark ponytail pressed flat in shadow just outside the edge of the beam, holding her breath, tense.
shots.line: The masts sweep in turns. Move only in the dark between them.
shots.action: The cone of light sweeps slowly past; she stays perfectly still.

shots.prompt: Inside a cold vault room lit by blue screens and server racks: an old round metal film canister from the 1950s lies on a steel table, a gloved hand reaching for it, frost on the metal, cold blue light, no writing anywhere.
shots.line: Copy the logs, and take whatever else the Directorate is hiding.
